Ontology Report
Sandwich Ontology
1 Introduction
A sandwich is simply bread plus filling, yet even Simple English Wikipedia lists open-faced,
toasted, double-decker, and panini—variants defined by slice and layer counts. The ontology
therefore models structural form only, leaving flavour and nutrition aside.
2 Classes
2.1 Core Classes
Core Class Role Modelling Rationale
Bread Each individual slice of bread Counting how many slices are

infer structural types, open-faced,
standard or double-deckers, without
hard-coding those categories.
Filling Any edible item placed between (or
on) bread.
